Enumeration Type Documentation

enum client_flags
 

flags for a client/view

Enumerator:
CF_NONE  no flags
CF_PAUSED  client/view isn't interested in updates right now

enum file_flags
 

bit-vector describing what data we already have

Enumerator:
FF_NONE  got nothing
FF_NAME  got name
FF_STAT  got stat()-info
FF_MIME  got MIME-type
FF_META  got meta-data
FF_THUMB  got thumbnail
FF_ANY  any of the "got"-flags?
FF_FIRST  issued when about to read first item in a folder
FF_LAST  issued after last item in a folder was read
FF_NAME_  got names for all items in folder
FF_STAT_  got stat-info for all items in folder
FF_MIME_  got mime-type for all items in folder
FF_META_  got other meta-data for all items in folder
FF_THUMB_  got thumbnails for all (applicable) items in folder
FF_ANY_  any of the "got all"-flags?
FF_SEMA  for directories
FF_UNSEEN  this item already clocked in?
FF_SORTED  deprecated

enum item_flags
 

non-POSIX flags for a file-info

Enumerator:
IF_NONE  no flags
IF_NOUSE  no 'x'
IF_NOMODIFY  no 'w'
IF_VIRTUAL  virtual item
IF_DOTDIR  ".folder"

enum model_event
 

Enumerator:
MODEL_UPD  update an item
MODEL_DEL  remove an item
MODEL_CWD  change directory
MODEL_MSC  miscellaneous, see file_flags for sub-type

enum pg_mode
 

path_get() mode

Enumerator:
PG_ENQUEUE_NOT  do note enqueue this directory
PG_ENQUEUE_ALL  read all directories along the path
PG_ENQUEUE_LAST  read only deepest directory in path
PG_ENQUEUE_PATH  create and examine elements of path only

enum queue_flags
 

what state a queue's worker is in

Enumerator:
QUEUE_NONE  thread does not exist
QUEUE_SCANNING  thread is busy
QUEUE_ZOMBIE  thread has terminated, must be joined

enum sort_flags
 

how to sort

Enumerator:
SORT_UNSORTED  don't sort
SORT_CASEFOLD  sort is case-insensitive
SORT_DIRS1ST  don't put directories in front
SORT_BANDNAMES  musicshop sort: ignore "the" etc.

in band-names

SORT_BYMIME  sort as "mp3.mysong" rather than "mysong.mp3"
SORT_BYSIZE  by size
SORT_BYDATE  by date
SORT_BYUSER  by user
SORT_BYMETA  by meta

enum vi_mode
 

how to handle duplicate names (not tags) in vfolders

Enumerator:
VIM_REPLACE  allow only one item with the same name
VIM_INDEX  index: "foo", "foo (1)", "foo (2)".

..

VIM_DIFF  diff: "foo (in bar)", "foo (in bazong)".

..

int model_path_get (  q_head *  qh,
file_info *  root,
char *  path,
pg_mode  pgm
) 
 

add all dirs along a given path to the model and enQ them for reading.

last element in path with be dequeued first (LIFO), as that's the one the user is most likely interested in.

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
qh the queue to place the directories/read-requests in
root the sub-tree of the model, or NULL for top
path the path to examine
pgm the enQ-mode (PG_ENQUEUE enQs all dirs along path for reading, PG_ENQUEUE_LAST enqueues deepest dir in path only)
